**Hotel Unique** is one of São Paulo’s most iconic and architecturally distinctive hotels, known for its bold, boat-shaped design and luxurious offerings. Here’s everything I know about it:

---

### **1. Overview & Location**
- **Name:** Hotel Unique
- **Location:** Avenida Brigadeiro Luís Antônio, 4700 – Jardim Paulista, São Paulo, Brazil (near Ibirapuera Park).
- **Opened:** 2002
- **Architect:** Ruy Ohtake (a renowned Brazilian architect, son of artist Tomie Ohtake).
- **Style:** Futuristic, avant-garde, and nautical-inspired (resembling a ship or a giant banana, depending on the angle).
- **Affiliation:** Part of the **Design Hotels** collection (a Marriott brand) and a member of **Preferred Hotels & Resorts**.

---

### **2. Architecture & Design**
- **Exterior:**
  - The hotel’s most striking feature is its **semi-circular, boat-like structure**, clad in **copper-colored aluminum panels** that oxidize over time, giving it a weathered, golden hue.
  - The design was inspired by **Oscar Niemeyer’s** curves and **Brazilian modernism**, with a playful, almost whimsical touch.
  - The building’s shape creates a **sense of movement**, as if it’s "floating" above the street.

- **Interior:**
  - Designed by **Fernando and Humberto Campana** (famous Brazilian designers), the interiors blend **luxury with artistic flair**.
  - **Lobby:** Features a **red carpet staircase** (resembling a tongue or a slide), a **giant chandelier** made of glass spheres, and **custom furniture** (e.g., the "Favela Chair" by the Campanas).
  - **Rooms:** Each of the **95 rooms and suites** has a **unique layout** due to the building’s curved shape. Decor includes **minimalist Brazilian design**, with **wooden floors, leather headboards, and floor-to-ceiling windows** offering city views.
  - **Skye Bar & Restaurant:** Located on the **rooftop**, with a **360° view of São Paulo** and a **glass-bottomed pool** (one of the few in the world).

---

### **3. Rooms & Suites**
- **Categories:**
  - **Standard Rooms** (30–40 sqm) – Curved walls, city views, king or twin beds.
  - **Superior Rooms** – Larger, with more amenities.
  - **Junior Suites** – Separate living area, some with terraces.
  - **Master Suites** – Spacious, with panoramic views and private terraces.
  - **Presidential Suite** – The most luxurious, with a **private pool**, sauna, and butler service.
- **Amenities:**
  - **Free Wi-Fi**, **iPod docks**, **minibars**, **Nespresso machines**, **Bose sound systems**, and **luxury toiletries** (by **Granado**, a Brazilian brand).
  - Some rooms have **hammocks** or **private balconies**.

---

### **4. Dining & Bars**
- **Skye Restaurant & Bar:**
  - **Location:** Rooftop (14th floor).
  - **Cuisine:** Modern Brazilian with international influences (chef **Emmanuel Bassoleil**).
  - **Highlights:**
    - **Glass-bottom pool** (diners can see swimmers below).
    - **Sunset views** over São Paulo.
    - **Live DJs** and a **vibrant nightlife scene** (one of the city’s best rooftop bars).
  - **Signature Dishes:** Moqueca (Brazilian fish stew), grilled meats, and creative cocktails.

- **Mezzanine Bar:**
  - Located in the lobby, offering **light bites, cocktails, and coffee**.
  - Features a **cozy, lounge-like atmosphere** with design pieces.

---

### **5. Wellness & Recreation**
- **Spa (Unique Spa by **Espa**):**
  - Offers **massages, facials, and body treatments** using **Brazilian ingredients** (e.g., cupuaçu butter, açaí).
  - **Signature Treatment:** "Brazilian Rainforest Ritual."
- **Fitness Center:**
  - Small but well-equipped, with **Technogym machines** and **personal trainers** available.
- **Rooftop Pool:**
  - **Infinity-edge pool** with **glass bottom** (overlooking the lobby).
  - **Heated** and open year-round.
  - **Poolside service** for drinks and snacks.

---

### **6. Unique Features & Experiences**
- **Glass-Bottom Pool:** One of the hotel’s most famous features—swimmers can be seen from the lobby and Skye Bar.
- **Art & Design:** The hotel is a **living art piece**, with **custom furniture, sculptures, and installations** throughout.
- **Events & Weddings:** Popular for **luxury weddings, fashion shows, and corporate events** due to its dramatic setting.
- **Butler Service:** Available for **suites and VIP guests**.
- **Pet-Friendly:** Allows small pets (with prior arrangement).

---

### **7. Awards & Recognition**
- **Condé Nast Traveler:** Ranked among the **"Top 100 Hotels in the World"** (2004, 2005).
- **Travel + Leisure:** Featured in **"It List"** (best new hotels).
- **Wallpaper* Design Awards:** Recognized for **best hotel design**.
- **Forbes Travel Guide:** Rated as a **4-star hotel**.

---

### **8. Nearby Attractions**
- **Ibirapuera Park** (5-min drive) – São Paulo’s most famous park, with museums, bike paths, and green spaces.
- **Avenida Paulista** (10-min drive) – The city’s financial and cultural hub, with museums (MASP), shops, and restaurants.
- **Jardins Neighborhood** – Upscale area with **boutiques, cafés, and art galleries**.
- **Oscar Freire Street** – Luxury shopping (e.g., **Daslu, Louis Vuitton**).
- **Japanese District (Liberdade)** – For authentic **ramen, sushi, and Asian markets**.

---

### **9. Practical Information**
- **Check-in/Check-out:** 3:00 PM / 12:00 PM.
- **Parking:** Valet service available (paid).
- **Airport Transfer:** Can be arranged (Guarulhos Airport is ~30–40 min away).
- **Accessibility:** Some rooms are **wheelchair-accessible**, but the curved design may limit options.
- **Dress Code:** **Smart casual** (especially at Skye Bar).

---

### **10. Controversies & Fun Facts**
- **Nicknames:** Locals call it the **"Banana Hotel"** or **"Ship Hotel"** due to its shape.
- **Celebrity Sightings:** Hosted **Madonna, Lady Gaga, Leonardo DiCaprio, and many fashion models** during São Paulo Fashion Week.
- **Architectural Debate:** Some critics argue the design is **impractical** (e.g., curved rooms make furniture placement tricky), but most praise its **boldness**.
- **Sustainability:** The hotel has **eco-friendly initiatives**, such as **water-saving systems** and **recycling programs**.

---

### **11. Why Stay Here?**
✅ **For Architecture Lovers** – A **must-see** for design enthusiasts.
✅ **For Luxury Seekers** – High-end amenities and **personalized service**.
✅ **For Nightlife & Views** – **Skye Bar** is one of the best rooftop spots in São Paulo.
✅ **For Instagram** – The **glass pool, red staircase, and copper facade** are **highly photogenic**.
❌ **Not Ideal For:**
   - **Budget travelers** (rates start around **$300–$500/night**).
   - **Those who prefer traditional hotels** (the design is **very unconventional**).
   - **Families with young kids** (the pool’s glass bottom may be a concern).

---

### **12. How to Book**
- **Official Website:** [www.hotelunique.com.br](https://www.hotelunique.com.br)
- **Booking Platforms:** Available on **Booking.com, Expedia, Marriott (Design Hotels), and Preferred Hotels**.
- **Best Time to Visit:** **March–May (fall)** or **September–November (spring)** for pleasant weather. Avoid **January–February** (rainy season) and **June–August** (cooler, but still busy).

---

### **Final Verdict**
Hotel Unique is **not just a place to stay—it’s an experience**. If you love **bold architecture, luxury, and a vibrant atmosphere**, it’s one of São Paulo’s most unforgettable hotels. However, if you prefer **classic elegance or budget-friendly options**, it might not be the best fit.
